# Architecture

Lagos Electoral Intelligence and Operations Platform. Last updated 2026-10-26.

## 1. What the source data actually is

Inspection showed that the "18 GB CSV" is **not a CSV**. It is a folder (`DONE/`) of **13,974 PDF files (18.25 GB)**. These are INEC
*Display Register* documents generated by PyFPDF, with a real text layer (no OCR needed) and embedded voter photographs.

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| Layout | `DONE/<NN>_<LGA>/<NN>_<WARD>/<NNN>_<PU name>[_<A-Z>_group_<A-Z>│_group]_<k>_of_<n>.pdf` |
| LGAs / wards (registration areas) / polling units | 20 / 245 / 13,232 unique PU keys |
| Fields per voter | serial, name, VIN, birth year, gender, PU delimitation code (`24-LL-WW-PPP`) |
| Not present | addresses, phone numbers |
| File sizes | 0.03–19 MB (mean 1.34 MB), mostly photographs |

Source defects found during inspection (all handled by the pipeline):

1. **Two copies of some polling units.** 706 PUs have both an alphabetical ("A-Z") copy and a default-order copy, with identical
   entries. Loading both naively would double-count those voters.
2. **The alphabetical copy marks every voter as male.** Names, VINs and birth years match the default copy exactly; only gender is wrong.
   1,153 PUs exist *only* as alphabetical copies, so their gender is reported as unavailable.
3. **Split files.** Some PUs are split by letter range across 2–9 files.
4. **Damaged PDFs.** Some files have broken cross-reference tables that pdfjs cannot read. pypdf recovers them.
5. **Formatting variants.** VINs are 18, 19 or 20 characters. A VIN value sometimes wraps onto the next line together with the birth-year text.

## 2. Components

```
            ┌──────────────── Windows host (8 GB RAM) ─────────────────┐
 Browser ──▶│  Express API (server/)  ── serves built SPA (dist/web)  │
  (React)   │     │  auth · RBAC · geo scope · audit · reports         │
            │     ▼                                                    │
            │  MongoDB 7 (127.0.0.1, WiredTiger cache 0.25 GB)         │
            │     ▲                                                    │
            │  Ingestion worker (worker/, CLI)  ◀── DONE/*.pdf (read-only)
            └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                  │ server-side SDK only
                  ▼
              Cloudinary (branding = public; officer documents = private + signed expiring URLs)
```

| Folder | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `shared/` | Roles/permissions table, geographic code helpers, metric definitions (used by API and UI) |
| `server/` | Express 5 API: sessions, TOTP MFA, rate limiting, CSRF header guard, RBAC, geographic scoping, audit, reports (CSV/XLSX/PDF), Cloudinary |
| `worker/` | Catalogue scanner, PDF text extraction (pdfjs, pypdf fallback), register parser, resumable ingestion, verification/aggregation/data-quality rules, CLI |
| `web/` | Vite + React 19 + Tailwind 4 SPA, MapLibre choropleth (no third-party basemap) |
| `scripts/` | Local MongoDB runner, synthetic demo seeder, user bootstrap, boundary import, read-only probes, smoke test, screenshots |
| `reference/boundaries/` | GRID3 2022 LGA polygons (CC BY 4.0) with source notes |
| `test/` | Vitest suites (parser, ingestion, API) using in-memory MongoDB and synthetic data only |

The browser never talks to MongoDB and receives no credentials. Only `dist/web` is served statically; the project root, `.env` and `DONE/` are never exposed (verified by the smoke test).

## 3. Data model (MongoDB)

Separate databases: `lagos_eip_register` (real register, restricted) and `lagos_eip_demo` (synthetic). The seeder and the worker each refuse to write into the other's database.

| Collection | Purpose | Sensitivity |
|---|---|---|
| `voter_records` | One document per (PU, VIN). `_id`=HMAC(PU‖VIN); `vh`=HMAC(VIN); `nk`=HMAC(normalised name‖birth year); `by` birth year; `g` gender (default copy only); `src` {file, page, serial}; `cp` copies seen | **Restricted, pseudonymised.** No names, no VINs, no photos |
| `ingest_rejects` | Rejected rows: file, page, serial, reason codes | Restricted (locations only) |
| `source_files` | Catalogue + per-file results (status, SHA-256, extractor, cover totals, counts, issue counts, sanitised error) | Internal |
| `import_jobs` | Job state, heartbeat, peak memory, stop reason | Internal |
| `agg_geo` | Aggregates for state/LGA/ward/PU: records, cover totals, rejected, gender, age bands, duplicate candidates, completeness | Aggregate |
| `geo_units` | Geographic reference built from register cover pages (`verified: true`) or folder names (`verified: false`) | Public geography |
| `geo_boundaries` | LGA polygons matched by name, with source and licence | Public |
| `dq_issues` | Data-quality issues: category, severity, scope, affected count, status, full history | Internal |
| `users`, `sessions` | Accounts (scrypt hashes, AES-GCM-encrypted TOTP secrets); sessions keyed by SHA-256 of the token | Restricted |
| `audit_events` | Append-only audit trail (no code path updates or deletes) | Restricted |
| `collation_templates`, `collation_submissions` | Configurable ward report form; submissions with versions, history, discrepancies, attachments | Internal |
| `export_log`, `media_assets`, `app_settings` | Export history, Cloudinary asset metadata, dataset mode, catalogue/verification summaries, authorisation attestation | Internal |

### Indexes (from actual query patterns)

- `voter_records`: `{pu}` (per-PU aggregation), `{vh}` (duplicate rule D1, VIN lookup), `{ward, nk}` (duplicate rule D2).
- `agg_geo`: `{parent}` (drill-down), `{level}` (ward/PU tables).
- `source_files`: `{status, relPath}` (job queue order), `{impliedPuCode}`.
- `dq_issues`: `{status, severity}`, `{lga, ward}` (scoped lists).
- `collation_submissions`: unique `{exercise, ward, templateId}`; `{lga, status}`.
- `audit_events`: `{at}`, `{actorId, at}`, `{action, at}`. `sessions`: TTL on `expiresAt`.

Measured in the pilot: **401 bytes per stored record**, including all indexes.

## 4. Ingestion pipeline

1. **Catalogue** (`ingest catalog`): walks the folders and records size and mtime per file. Unchanged files are skipped, changed files are flagged `changed`, and missing files are reported (never deleted).
2. **Job run** (`ingest pilot|run`):
   - processes one file at a time;
   - extracts text with pdfjs, falling back to pypdf when pages fail;
   - parses the text and validates each row;
   - upserts records in batches of 1,000 with deterministic ids;
   - writes rejects;
   - marks the file `done` only after all writes complete.
   - **Memory guard:** checks RSS after every file and stops safely above the limit (default 700 MB).
   - **Heartbeat:** prevents two workers from running at once. A stale job is detected and taken over.
   - **Crash recovery:** files left in `processing` return to `pending`. Because ids are deterministic, re-processing never duplicates.
   - **Failures:** a failed file is not retried in the same run (max 3 attempts in total).
3. **Verify** (`ingest verify`): recomputes everything from stored state:
   - per-PU reconciliation (cover total = stored + rejected);
   - copy agreement;
   - aggregates for every level;
   - the geographic reference;
   - all data-quality issues. Issues no longer detected are auto-resolved, with history kept.
4. **Gates for a full run:** real keys configured, an authorisation attestation recorded, a balanced pilot verification on record, and the disk estimate passed.

### Data-quality rules

| Category | Severity | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| FILE_UNREADABLE | critical | Neither extractor could read the file / no PU code on cover |
| COUNT_MISMATCH | critical | Stored + rejected ≠ printed cover total (complete PUs only) |
| VARIANT_DISAGREEMENT | high | A-Z and default copies differ in count, or the second copy inserted new ids |
| COVER_CODE_MISMATCH | high | Printed PU code ≠ folder location |
| ROWS_REJECTED | high | Missing/malformed VIN or missing name |
| DUPLICATE_VIN_ACROSS_PUS (D1) | high | Same VIN hash in more than one PU |
| FILE_CHANGED_AFTER_IMPORT | high | Size/mtime changed after processing |
| GENDER_UNAVAILABLE | medium | Only the alphabetical copy exists |
| POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_REGISTRATION (D2) | medium | Same normalised name + birth year, different VIN, same ward (candidates only) |
| SERIAL_GAP, UNRECOGNISED_PAGES | medium | Sequence gaps, unreadable/unknown pages |
| BIRTH_YEAR_IMPLAUSIBLE | low | Missing, or implies age < 18 or > 120 (record kept) |
| GEO_UNMATCHED_BOUNDARY | low | No boundary polygon matched the area name |

## 5. Security model (summary — see Security_and_Privacy.md)

- Server-side RBAC (7 roles) plus geographic scope (state / LGA list / ward list) on every route.
- Mandatory TOTP MFA for System Administrator, Data Steward, Auditor and Report Reviewer.
- Sessions: random 256-bit token in an httpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie. Only its SHA-256 is stored. Idle timeout 60 min, absolute 12 h.
- Revocation, role changes and password resets delete the user's sessions immediately.
- Rate limits on login (per IP and per account), MFA and the API. Accounts lock for 15 minutes after 5 failures.
- A custom request header is required on every state-changing call (CSRF), with a strict CSP and Helmet defaults.

## 6. Geography and maps

- LGA polygons: GRID3 Nigeria 2022 via geoBoundaries (CC BY 4.0). 20/20 Lagos LGAs matched; "Ifako/Ijaye" matched via one reviewed alias. Three neighbouring Ogun polygons are reported as unmatched.
- **Ward and polling-unit boundaries are not available** from a verified source. INEC registration areas differ from administrative wards, so those levels are shown as tables, never guessed shapes.
- The map uses no external tiles, so no request leaves the platform. Every map view has a table with the same values.
